# ReadPad2 ($008908) capture (generated by runs/gen_pad2_capture.py).
# ReadPad2 is only called in the pad control modes (1 = 2 JOYPAD, 5 = 1P JOYPAD).
# The emulator always puts a Menacer on port 2, so the 2 JOYPAD game is loaded straight
# from the 2p_pad_* state (the menu refuses that row with a Menacer, docs/gun.md). Port 2
# answers ReadPad2 with the Menacer's data register, driven by the mouse. After the
# swap-back $FF8050 holds pad 2, so `peek pad2 FF8050 2` logs the word ReadPad2 produced.
load states/2p_pad_05.state
